item.title: Oxford UK heavy rock four-piece Stud Farm Mafia release their debut EP “Did You Have a Good Weekend?” March 17th
item.description: Stud Farm Mafia don’t just want to know if you had a good weekend: they want to know what you’re doing with the rest of your life. item.description: The Wolfe Tones The SSE Arena, Belfast: Saturday 29 August Tickets on sale Friday 6 February at 9am The Wolfe Tones have today announced further Irish dates for summer 2026, with new shows confirmed for Killarney and Belfast. This announcement follows the sell-out of three of the band’s four dates at the 3Arena, with exceptional demand continuing for the remaining show.
